title: Executed terminal accumulation and bit reuse: conditional κ = 6.16027622e-4
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This composes our #170 bit-output fusion and compensated lifetime reuse with #168's newer modules, refines the complex frames, and integrates #166's terminal compiler into an actual all-column-checked executor. The resulting conditional bound is

$$T(n)=O\bigl(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\bigr),\qquad \kappa=\frac{308013811}{500000000000}=6.16027622\times10^{-4}.$$

This is **+0.4988% over #173's advertised 6.129700e-4**, and **+3.219% over #170**. Concurrent #186 reports 0.000661885549259598, which is higher; this package is a separately checked contribution, not a current-record claim. These compare exponent savings, not measured runtimes. Stacked on #169 at `4895ba1104cedc7908b6d6ba64fdd6290e0ed7ae`; #168's words/modules/arcs and the inherited assembly are prerequisites.

| Supplier | Physical auxiliary roles | W | Certified local saving |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Complex, with 66 target-accumulated terminals | 12,135 | 14,775 | 0.000616407346 |
| Bit, fused outputs and 1,760 compensated reuses | 18,732 | 22,252 | 0.000646746861 coarse |

The complex side binds. Each removed terminal preserves the independently valued targets and eliminates three width-18 and three width-4 children. The actual new executor retains the **original dirty-response columns of every surviving role**, executes the target pre/post shears and accumulation writes, and restores every remaining dirty coordinate. Its coefficient bound is recomputed through this changed word before the exact packed rational replay.

The bit construction is regenerated from frozen arcs; every operation/frame binding, aliased birth, and actual target-read chronology is checked. All 25,849 original and replacement rational bit frames receive exact Gram/factor witnesses, so every retained prime q > 2^80 remains valid. Discovery-time frame IDs were explicitly matched by a complete frame-record bijection to the frozen compiler's IDs before binding the release inputs.

The inherited all-size Clifford/shared-core, weighted local-ring, restored-row, analytic recovery, balanced-layout and fixed-tape interfaces remain assumptions. No unconditional theorem, global optimum or practical speedup is claimed. The main selected certificate is not replaced; this is an additive research package.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/paired-cube-terminal-reuse/verify.py
```

- Complete source reconstruction and certificate generation passed locally (198 s, standard-library Python).
- Both complex shear directions check every rational source, target and physical dirty column; the bit word checks every F2 column and the defining integer decoder.
- Missing compensation, stale reuse, missing partner delivery, omitted target pre/post shears and terminal writes are rejected; geometric mutation controls remain active.
- Both paid supplier moments, the full finite bridge, all **47 strict constraints and seven margins**, and the next supplier/final grid-point rejections pass. Full group, original logical scalar stock, routing, common-grid precision, bit fallback and row reserves remain charged.
- The complete package verifier passed on a clean GitHub-hosted Python 3.13 checkout: https://github.com/huxint/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37927509885. `make paired-cube-verify` also passed locally.
- Python 3.12 exposed only a gzip OS-header mismatch in temporary input hashes; the header is now normalized and all seven payloads were checked byte-for-byte against the Python 3.13+ form. The final Python 3.12 clean read-only reproduction passed (227 s), and the final Python 3.13 CI also passed: https://github.com/huxint/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37928449316. The full historical `make verify` suite also passed in a separate checkout with Boost headers supplied locally.

Proof, source pins and receipts: `research/paired-cube-terminal-reuse/{PROOF.md,SOURCE.json,certificate.json}`.

## Credits

The terminal identity/checker are **@jamesyc's #166**, following the Dumas–Grenet accumulation literature; the compiler identity is not claimed as new here. This adds its transformed executor, a new formal bound/replay, instantiation on #168 and complete supplier/assembly integration. The retained rational-column checker is @chafreaky's #163–#165 lineage as corrected/adapted in @jon314159's #171; @GamingPuzzled's #169 supplies the bit-column and prime routines. Original source files/notices are retained.

@icekylinx and contributors supply the paired-cube and shared-core framework; @eumemic supplies #168's modules, words and physical layer; @DaysSky supplies closure compilation; @an664 supplies core sharing; Zhihao Chen, Swapnil Jain, the RaD project and the paid-atom/phase-stop contributors retain their upstream credits. Full attribution is in `NOTICE`.
